title: BA1/2215/2019 of MANISH KALONI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
BA1 No. 2215 of 2019
Hon'ble N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. T.P.S. Takuli, Advocate for the
applicant.
Mrs. Shivali Joshi, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
This is first bail application moved by
the applicant who is in jail in connection
with FIR No. 01 of 2015, offences punishable
u/s 409, 420, 467 & 468 of IPC, registered at
Police Station Patti Area Mangoli
(Lohaghat), District Champawat.
Heard learned counsel for the parties
and considered the grounds taken up in the
bail application.
Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that the applicant has falsely been
implicated in the instant case; has no
previous criminal history and is languishing
in jail since 01.09.2019. He also submits that
the applicant is ready to deposit Rs.
7,66,000/- before the concerned Court. He
further submits that in case, the applicant is
granted bail, he will not misuse the same
and will furnish the bail surety as per the
satisfaction of this Court.
Learned State Counsel would submit
that she has no objection, if the applicant
deposits Rs. 7,66,000/- before the Court
below.
Amount so deposited by the applicant
shall be invested in interest earning
FDR/TDR with a nationalized bank, subject
to final outcome of the criminal case.
Considering the submission of learned
counsel for the parties and without
expressing any opinion as to the final merits

of the case, this Court is of the view that
applicant deserves bail at this stage.
The bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant be released on bail,
on executing a personal bond and
furnishing two reliable sureties, each of like
amount, to the satisfaction of Court
concerned.
Let a certified copy of this order be
issued to the learned counsel for the parties,
by 10.01.2020, on payment of usual charges.
